description: An understand run on the Catalog and Services areas whose first task reads a file and then writes twelve BR cards of one claim each, using about 33,000 tokens; the Services task would read one file and give no card. At a run cap of 100,000 tokens the twelve claims cannot all be judged with the verifier share, so the Services task must not start (P5-20). Written by hand for the fake provider; no real provider was called.
